config.title: STM32 One-Click Build & Flash
config.programmer.description: Optional: manually specify the absolute path to the STM32CubeProgrammer CLI
config.toolchainDirs.description: Optional: manually specify the directories containing cmake / ninja / arm-none-eabi-gcc
config.extraPathDirs.description: Optional: extra directories prepended to PATH. At build time objcopy / size are invoked by bare file name - the CMake template sets CMAKE_OBJCOPY / CMAKE_SIZE to arm-none-eabi-objcopy / arm-none-eabi-size - so if they are reported as not found, put their bin directory here
config.buildDir.description: Remembered build directory, relative to the workspace, for example build/Debug. Written automatically after you pick one when Debug/Release both exist; leave empty to pick automatically each time - a picker is shown when there are several candidates
config.programmerArgs.description: Programmer arguments; {elf} is replaced with the absolute firmware path. Default: connect over SWD, write and verify, then reset and run
config.buildOnly.description: Build only, do not flash - useful to verify that the project builds when the board is not at hand
config.clearBeforeRun.description: Clear the terminal before each run. Default false, which keeps the previous output for review
